raw.body:
fix: address ac-46638 review findings on the XPath 1.0 boundary

Review remediation for the version-routing candidate, all six findings:

README no longer recommends the bare "type: xpath" form its own routing
rejects - the three migration pointers name the versioned Selector
Object form, the Selector Objects section states the explicit xpath-10
requirement with per-caller rejection behavior and the
validate-accepts/run-rejects cliff, and the prefix paragraph notes the
textual fallback for prefixes not declared on the document element.

The backend borrows the caller's bytes again: uppsala::parse over the
checked UTF-8 text instead of parse_bytes, removing an unforced ~1.6x
deep-clone cost that every criterion, selector, output, and watch paid.

The prefix test gains the discriminating case for URI resolution: a
descendant re-binding of the same prefix text to a different URI
matches only the root-scoped element, count 1.

The conformance claim runtime.xpath-version-dispatch re-owns its
residual (no XPath 3.1 engine) to ac-d45cd behind the ac-4c05c backend
decision, since dispatch itself is delivered here. The bench's direct
uppsala usage is recorded as a deliberate raw-library baseline seam.
finite_number_value has one decision point for non-finite input, and
the extract_xpath comment states the inf/NaN null degrade is new.
